answer_1.quote: Our method aims to create customized LLMs that adopt the idiolect of the target writer while retaining the ability to understand and follow natural language instructions.
answer_1.outputs: text continuations in the style of specific authors

answer_2.quote: Inspired by earlier studies of author style, we evaluate our stylized generation across three dimensions: perplexity on withheld text, style-embedding alignment, and linguistic alignment.
